caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright, dark brown glass bottle with a narrow neck and slightly wider body, tapering towards the base. The bottle has a glossy appearance and reflects light, indicating a shiny surface. Inscribed on the bottle’s surface are the words “Catskill Mountains, Augt. 15th, 1862, 'We four', Athen N.Y.,” written in a cursive script. The bottle is centrally placed on a light beige or tan background, with its shadow and highlights carefully rendered to show its three-dimensional form. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset image showing the same bottle from a slightly different perspective, providing an additional view of its shape. The artist’s signature, “F. Pomagalli,” appears in the bottom right corner of the main image. The overall composition is simple and focuses attention completely on the bottle and its inscription.
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
